Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We acknowledge your offer and the cost drivers you have outlined. In line with your approval rules, please submit our price proposal below to your pricing committee for approval, as it exceeds your key account manager’s authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 361.96 per unit, 90 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,211,576 over the term.
3. Basis: Our demand forecast for this part is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09), and we commit 6,110 units a year. Your quality over the last 12 months was 273 ppm (sc:70510@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 12-month agreement for 6,110 units, about EUR 2,211,576. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. We confirm receipt of your data regarding the PPI-C241 index and the volume increase, which we have factored into our revised calculation. We must decline the requested 90-day payment term, as it would significantly increase the unit price, and therefore maintain our 30-day terms. Please be advised that as Key Account Manager, I hold full authority to conclude this agreement, and we propose a revised price of EUR 368.42 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms, we offer a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.42 per unit.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
